description: Shared frontend/backend fixtures for the read-only view of someone else's deck (Share/7, #429): the published revision of a deck behind its public code, for guests and any account. GET and HEAD only; the Bearer token is optional (no token is a guest, a valid token identifies the account, a present but invalid Bearer token is 401 and is never treated as a guest). Responses are no-store and vary with the bearer. Problem shapes follow RFC 9457 as everywhere. `invariants` are executable: the integration tests compare the real answers with the property sets of these examples. The media of the published revision has its own route (Share/9, #431): signed links to DERIVED variants only, never the original, and the exercise list never carries answers or authoring titles.

rateLimit.scope: per instance: a guest per client network (IPv4 address, IPv6 /64) and, for IPv6, all guests of one /48 together; guests that find the guest table full share one overflow bucket; a signed-in viewer per account (a separate table, never starved by guests); an account is admitted before Identity is asked about its token, so one token cannot drive unlimited Identity round trips

bulkhead.note: reads served at once per instance; guests may hold all but one place, so one is always free for a signed-in viewer; the next read is refused immediately instead of waiting for a connection

constants.mediaKillSwitch: learning.community.public-media.enabled (default false: the media route answers 404 as if absent; it also needs learning.community.public-routes.enabled)

mediaRateLimit.scope: per instance, counting REQUESTS FOR SIGNED LINKS, not bytes (the object store serves the bytes after a link is handed out, so these limits bound how fast links are minted, not the egress itself): a guest per client network (IPv4 address, IPv6 /64), for IPv6 all guests of one /48 together (a request must pass both), and all guests together per deck; a signed-in viewer is limited per account by the public chain and is never counted against the deck; a key that finds its table full shares the table's overflow bucket

constants.mediaUrlTtl: PT10M (learning.community.public-media.url-ttl, five minutes to two hours): the signed links of a guest are shorter-lived than the owner's playback links (learning.media.playback.url-ttl, PT1H)

invariants: an unknown code, a code rotated away, a private deck, a deleted deck and a deck without a published revision answer the same 404 (only `instance` differs)
an invitation-only deck answers 403 DECK_INVITE_ONLY to a viewer without a grant, with no title, description, owner or member data
a non-owner reads the PUBLISHED revision only; the owner on these routes reads it too (his own routes keep reading the head)
slug is present only when visibility is PUBLIC

items.page.items are in manifest order, ordinal continues across pages, nextCursor is null on the last page, cursors are opaque and bound to the published revision (a republication makes an old cursor 412)
an item that is not in the published manifest is 404 even if the deck's head has it

exercises carry exerciseId, exerciseRevisionId, ordinal, type, enabled and a plain-text prompt summary only (no authoring title): never answer keys, options, references, transcripts, bindings or evaluator policies
no response carries a deck id, a deck revision or version, draft ids, journal data or origin deck ids
every answer is Cache-Control: no-store with Vary: Authorization
pageDefault <= pageMax; limit outside 1..pageMax, repeated parameters and malformed cursors are 400
ownerId is returned on purpose: the UI needs it to ask Identity for the author's card; the card (name, avatar) is consent-gated in Identity (Share/1), Learning exposes only the opaque account id
a link changes (the old code answers 404) whenever the level moves to a more restrictive one: PUBLIC > LINK > INVITE > PRIVATE, every step down included; raising the level keeps the code
a read or media request refused by the bulkhead is 503 PUBLIC_READ_BUSY with Retry-After before any lookup, so it says nothing about the code

media: GET /api/public/decks/{code}/media/{assetId} answers {assetId, state, playback, poster} for an asset that a MATERIAL of the published revision references; playback and poster are null unless state is READY, poster is also null when the asset has no poster or thumbnail variant

media: only the media of materials is offered; the media of exercises is not (the public view shows exercises as plain-text prompts and an exercise pin does not say whether an asset belongs to the question or to the answer), so an exercise-only asset is the same 404 for every viewer, the owner included

media: state is READY, the state of an upload that is still going (PENDING_UPLOAD, VERIFYING, PROCESSING) or UNAVAILABLE; a rejected, failed or deleted asset is UNAVAILABLE for a non-owner, whatever the reason

media: playback and poster are short-lived signed links of DERIVED variants (playback, poster or thumbnail) as {url, expiresAt, mimeType}; the links live ten minutes by default; the verified original, a download link and any object key never appear, whoever asks
media: the answer is Cache-Control: private, no-store with Vary: Authorization (a signed link is a credential of the moment)

media: access is DeckAccess to the deck behind the code (any level that grants a published revision) AND the asset in the deck's published material set; an unknown or rotated code, a private deck, an invitation-only deck for a viewer without a grant (404 here, not 403), a deck without a published revision, an asset that is not in the published set (a change the owner has not published, an asset removed by a republication, an exercise-only asset, an asset of another deck) and an unknown asset id are the same 404
media: a malformed asset id is 400; a present but invalid bearer is 401 as everywhere; the media route is 404 while its kill switch is off
media: the requests are counted as mnema_public_media_requests_total{outcome} (ok, not_found, rate_limited, busy, disabled, unavailable); neither the code nor the asset id is a label

exercises.promptRules: the TEXT blocks of the prompt slot joined by a space, whitespace collapsed; a cloze without prompt text shows its passage with each blank as an ellipsis; at most promptMaxCodePoints code points, then an ellipsis; null when the question has no plain text

body.title: Resource not found
body.detail: The requested resource does not exist.

body.title: Deck is invite only
body.detail: The deck is shared by invitation.

body.title: Rate limited
body.detail: Too many requests; retry after the time in Retry-After.

body.title: Version conflict
body.detail: The resource changed after the supplied version was read.

body.title: Invalid request
body.detail: The request is invalid or cannot be read.

invalidToken.note: a present but invalid, expired or revoked Bearer token; an absent token is a guest and never 401

body.title: Public reads busy
body.detail: Public reads are busy; retry after the time in Retry-After.

media.rules: the answer has exactly these four members; there is no download, original or objectKey member; a state other than READY carries null links; UNAVAILABLE covers rejected, failed and deleted assets; every refusal is the notFound problem
